scope: Local unpublished fixes for furniture move visibility, type-locked hammer gestures without a selector, and structural tool detail thumbnails; material-part and camera proposals are discussion only
environment: macOS / Apple M1 Pro / Godot4.6.3 / Metal Forward+ / isolated test progress
root_causes: Moving hides source furniture and mounted objects; incremental commit reused hidden nodes but never restored their visibility
Default all-types range demolition swept floor, walls and objects together
Structural placement tools did not populate the detail panel preview row, despite valid catalog thumbnail textures
fixes: Restore furniture and attached-object visibility after successful moves including no-op drops, while keeping the same mesh/light instances
Infer and lock the gesture type at mouse-down; wall/floor/object drags cannot sweep other categories, while normal support cascades still apply
Remove the demolition dropdown and manual filter state; retain click removal for roof, doors and windows
Populate floor/wall/roof/door/window tool details from cached real-model thumbnails
not_implemented: Three indoor camera modes and switching controls
player_save_migration: Not needed in this revision; no player progress files were edited
